args.summary: Deployed version v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production with an elevated error rate (~18%). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback executed and verified; service is running v2.3.0 in all regions.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: Current production version **v2.3.1** was unhealthy with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback executed and verified.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.
